reference_measure: Dissolved dye amount per compartment volume; equal-volume compartments also permit counting measure. Neither log-orthopolic nor linear-orthopolic size allocation.
observation_model: Per-run affine raw absorbance against known nominal standard concentration. Independent Gaussian errors with a common variance within each run across standards and chamber samples; five standards do not establish this assumption.
forecast_estimator: Equal average of four independently fitted calibration exponential kernels, conditional on both measured target baselines; no target rate fit.
benchmarks: empirical mean calibration contrast kernel with linear interpolation and flat extrapolation
primary_score: Mean absolute contrast error divided by each pair's initial corrected total, averaged over seven later times and then four target pairs.
stock_score: Separate sampling-adjusted total-stock residual covariance test; not inferred from a kinetic benchmark win.
publication_exposure: Published aggregate diffusivities, four automated-cohort diffusivities and qualitative method comparison known. No selected-cohort raw absorbance, calibration-standard values or notebook outputs inspected before this protocol.
